data.name: Shatrughna
data.gender_notes: Shatrughna is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śatru, 'enemy', + ghna, 'slayer' — Śatrughna. Its root is Sanskrit śatru + ghna. Shatrughna, brother of Rama. Shatrughna is a Sanskrit name meaning “Slayer of enemies”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shatrughna expresses “Slayer of enemies”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit śatru, 'enemy', + ghna, 'slayer' — Śatrughna.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shatrughna total 45, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_english.name: Shatrughna
in_english.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śatru, 'enemy', + ghna, 'slayer' — Śatrughna. Its root is Sanskrit śatru + ghna. Shatrughna, brother of Rama. Shatrughna is a Sanskrit name meaning “Slayer of enemies”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.cultural_impact: Shatrughna is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “Slayer of enemies”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Shatrughna is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Slayer of enemies” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Shatrughna; such symbolism is interpretive.

faq.q: From which word is Shatrughna derived?
faq.a: From the Sanskrit śatru, 'enemy', + ghna, 'slayer' — Śatrughna.

faq.q: Is Shatrughna mentioned in scripture or history?
What is the historical or scriptural reference for Shatrughna?
What is the lucky number for Shatrughna?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Shatrughna is 9 (ruling planet Mars). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Shatrughna?
faq.a: Tuesday is the traditional association for Shatrughna. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Shatrughna?
faq.a: Red Coral is the traditional association for Shatrughna. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Shatrughna?
faq.a: Red, Crimson are the traditional associations for Shatrughna. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of Shatrughna?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shatrughna total 45, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

faq.q: How reliable is the meaning given for Shatrughna?
faq.a: The meaning of Shatrughna carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.q: Does Shatrughna have a religious meaning?
faq.a: Shatrughna is recorded as a hindu name meaning “Slayer of enemies”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Shatrughna?
faq.a: In English, Shatrughna is rendered as “Slayer of enemies”.

faq.q: Is Shatrughna suitable for a baby?
faq.a: Shatrughna is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.
